items.title: Submit proof of use of Bauspardarlehen (heating company invoice or signed order)
items.quote: Bitte reichen Sie den Nachweis binnen 10 Arbeitstagen nach dem Briefdatum ein.
items.computation: The letter is dated 21.11.2026 (a Saturday) and the period runs 'nach dem Briefdatum' (from the letter's date), so under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (21.11.2026) is not counted and counting starts 22.11.2026. The period is 10 Arbeitstage, defined by the letter itself as Monday-Friday excluding statutory public holidays (so effectively German business days per § 193 BGB). Counting 10 business days forward from 21.11.2026: Mon 23.11, Tue 24.11, Wed 25.11, Thu 26.11, Fri 27.11 (5), Mon 30.11, Tue 1.12, Wed 2.12, Thu 3.12, Fri 4.12 (10). 4.12.2026 is a Friday and not a public holiday in NRW, so no further shift is needed.

warnings: If the proof does not arrive in time, the letter states the loan disbursement will simply shift to the next first of the month rather than imposing a penalty, so this is a company deadline, not a legally binding one with remedy rights.
